subject: Updated modules examples to reference Valkey* (#342)
reason: The change only renames RedisModule* identifiers to their ValkeyModule* aliases inside the example modules in src/modules/ (helloacl, helloblock, hellocluster, hellodict, hellohook, hellotimer, hellotype, helloworld). These examples are not built into or loaded by valkey-server, so no server command, reply, replication, persistence, or tool behaviour changes; there is no runtime path for a scenario to exercise.
